key_point: Kingdom Hearts began in an elevator
title: Kingdom Hearts began in an elevator
caption: Kingdom Hearts started with a chance meeting in an elevator. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #kingdomhearts #squareenix

instagram.caption:
Kingdom Hearts exists because of an elevator ride.

Square and Disney Japan shared a building in Tokyo. Producer Shinji Hashimoto ran into a Disney executive in the elevator, and they started talking.

That chat led to Sora, Donald and Goofy, and a series that mixed Final Fantasy with Disney worlds.

Kingdom Hearts fans, how far in are you?
